citations.sql_query: SELECT p.promo_id, p.promo_name, p.promo_channel, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS net_sales FROM commerce.promotions AS p INNER JOIN commerce.order_items AS oi ON (oi.promo_id = p.promo_id OR oi.promo_id_2 = p.promo_id) INNER JOIN commerce.orders AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date BETWEEN p.start_date AND p.end_date AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.start_date) = 2022 GROUP BY p.promo_id, p.promo_name, p.promo_channel ORDER BY net_sales DESC LIMIT 100
